                MODEL EFFICIENCY OF DIFFERENT METHODS
                                                                                 In this article, an MSCANet and a new high-resolution
                                                                              dataset (CLCD) are proposed for cropland CD. The MSCANet
                                                                              employs a CNN-transformer structure, in which a pre-trained
                                                                              ResNet-18 is adopted to extract hierarchical features. Then, a
                                                                              transformer-based MSCA module is designed to encode and
                                                                              decode the context information in the multiscale features, with
                                                                              context aggregate connections applied to help feature fusion
                                                                              and aggregation across different levels. In the end, an MBPH
                                                                              is used to help enhance feature learning and capture more useful
